request.spec:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest
added on a tie (a member with no cut gets none; a pool with no non-zero cut gives it to the last
member with a share).
request.prompt:

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

agent.result_text:
A pool's leftover amount now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, and the latest-added member wins a tie. Before, it went to the member with the largest share, earliest-added on a tie. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is entirely on the server, in `cuts()` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/pool/PoolService.java`, where cuts are worked out. The front end only shows what the server sends, and no stored data or audit records change.

- **Members with no cut:** retired or held people show 0.00 and never get the leftover. Members whose dates leave out the sheet's today get no cut at all, so they don't get it either.
- **When every cut rounds to 0.00:** the leftover goes to the last-added member who isn't retired or held. I read "the last member with a share" that way, because giving it to a held person would contradict "a member with no cut gets none."

I also updated the two doc comments that described the old rule. The second of those edits, a line-wrap, was made after the build had started. It touches comments only, so it doesn't affect the result.
